name: The Lobby
description: See every agent in every worktree in one live view: a pixel room per project, compact Attention rows for results to review, org charts, context and tokens. Local and paired-server agents, with no telemetry. Tour and guide: https://lilykos.github.io/orca-the-lobby/

cover.alt: The Lobby: the pixel title and orca mascot, a tagline, and two project rooms with Need you!, Stuck? and Failed speech bubbles

screenshots.alt: The Office tab in Grid: two project rooms with pixel agents at their desks, today's tokens and the first agents of each room
screenshots.caption: Every agent, every worktree, one glance

screenshots.alt: Compact task-first Attention: title opens details; Open agent is separate; Reviewed is in result details; Finished stays counted while collapsed
screenshots.caption: Know what needs a look

screenshots.alt: The Activity tab: an org chart for one project, with a coordinator and the three workers it started
screenshots.caption: See who started whom

screenshots.alt: The agent drawer over the Office: context, tokens today, Go to agent, View in Activity and an instruction box
screenshots.caption: Jump in without hunting tabs

screenshots.alt: The agent drawer's context line: 81% of a 400k window, one compaction, 1.9M tokens today and the workspace's cache share
screenshots.caption: Context and tokens, per agent

screenshots.alt: The Office tab in the light theme, with the daytime window: two project rooms in Grid
screenshots.caption: Day or night, Orca's theme or five palettes
